outline.rationale: The user is a total beginner targeting hands-on model building, so the outline front-loads tooling setup and a conceptual grounding, then weaves math in as a just-in-time node rather than a separate theory track (matching the confirmed plan). Core practical skills—building a first model, the train-evaluate-improve loop, and data prep—form the backbone since these are what shipping a model actually requires. Trees/ensembles and a gentle neural-net intro broaden the toolkit without diving into rigorous derivations. A capstone project node ties it together into the full workflow. Excluded: history of ML, deep mathematical proofs, advanced theory, and unsupervised-heavy tracks, all of which the understanding flagged as low-priority for a builder.
